audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar Levite substitution and census text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Aaronic line, Nadab/Abihu reminder, Levite service, substitution for firstborn, clan assignments, Levite census, firstborn census, and redemption silver.

verses.restored: These are generations of Aaron and Moses in day YHWH spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.

familiar.text: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spake with Moses in mount Sinai.

modern.text: This is the account of Aaron and Moses at the time the LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.

original.text: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֥ת אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּמֹשֶׁ֑ה בְּי֗וֹם דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּהַ֥ר סִינָֽי

verses.restored: These are names of sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

familiar.text: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

modern.text: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, then Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

original.text: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַבְּכ֣וֹר נָדָ֑ב וַאֲבִיה֕וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר

verses.restored: These are names of sons of Aaron, anointed priests whose hand was filled to serve as priests.

familiar.text: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

modern.text: These were Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.

original.text: אֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים הַמְּשֻׁחִ֑ים אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּ֥א יָדָ֖ם לְכַהֵֽן

verses.restored: Nadab and Abihu died before YHWH when they brought near unauthorized fire before YHWH in wilderness of Sinai, and sons they had none; Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests before Aaron their father.

familiar.text: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD, when they offered strange fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the sight of Aaron their father.

modern.text: Nadab and Abihu, however, died in the presence of the LORD when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD in the Wilderness of Sinai. And since they had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron. The Duties of the Levites

original.text: וַיָּ֣מָת נָדָ֣ב וַאֲבִיה֣וּא לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֡ה בְּֽהַקְרִבָם֩ אֵ֨שׁ זָרָ֜ה לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר סִינַ֔י וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא הָי֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וַיְכַהֵ֤ן אֶלְעָזָר֙ וְאִ֣יתָמָ֔ר עַל פְּנֵ֖י אַהֲרֹ֥ן אֲבִיהֶֽם

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Bring tribe of Levi near and stand them before Aaron the priest, and they shall serve him.

familiar.text: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.

modern.text: “Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.

original.text: הַקְרֵב֙ אֶת מַטֵּ֣ה לֵוִ֔י וְֽהַעֲמַדְתָּ֣ אֹת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְשֵׁרְת֖וּ אֹתֽוֹ

verses.restored: They shall keep his charge and charge of all congregation before tent of meeting, to serve service of dwelling-place.

familiar.text: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.

modern.text: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, attending to the service of the tabernacle.

original.text: וְשָׁמְר֣וּ אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתּ֗וֹ וְאֶת מִשְׁמֶ֨רֶת֙ כָּל הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן

verses.restored: They shall keep all vessels of tent of meeting and charge of children of Israel, to serve service of dwelling-place.

familiar.text: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

modern.text: They shall take care of all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting and fulfill obligations for the Israelites by attending to the service of the tabernacle.

original.text: וְשָׁמְר֗וּ אֶֽת כָּל כְּלֵי֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְאֶת מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן

verses.restored: You shall give Levites to Aaron and his sons; given, given they are to him from children of Israel.

familiar.text: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.

modern.text: Assign the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they have been given exclusively to him from among the Israelites.

original.text: וְנָתַתָּה֙ אֶת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו נְתוּנִ֨ם נְתוּנִ֥ם הֵ֨מָּה֙ ל֔וֹ מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Aaron and his sons you shall appoint, and they shall keep their priesthood; outsider who draws near shall die.

familiar.text: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest’s office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

modern.text: So you shall appoint Aaron and his sons to carry out the duties of the priesthood; but any outsider who approaches the tabernacle must be put to death.”

original.text: וְאֶת אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְאֶת בָּנָיו֙ תִּפְקֹ֔ד וְשָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת כְּהֻנָּתָ֑ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Look, I have taken Levites from midst of children of Israel in place of every firstborn opening womb among children of Israel; Levites shall be mine.

familiar.text: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;

modern.text: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel in place of every firstborn Israelite from the womb. The Levites belong to Me,

original.text: וַאֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה לָקַ֣חְתִּי אֶת הַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִתּוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תַּ֧חַת כָּל בְּכ֛וֹר פֶּ֥טֶר רֶ֖חֶם מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י הַלְוִיִּֽם

verses.restored: For every firstborn is mine. On day I struck every firstborn in land of Egypt, I sanctified to myself every firstborn in Israel, from human to beast; mine they shall be. I am YHWH.

familiar.text: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the LORD.

modern.text: for all the firstborn are Mine. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated to Myself all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast. They are Mine; I am the LORD.” The Numbering of the Levites

original.text: כִּ֣י לִי֮ כָּל בְּכוֹר֒ בְּיוֹם֩ הַכֹּתִ֨י כָל בְּכ֜וֹר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם הִקְדַּ֨שְׁתִּי לִ֤י כָל בְּכוֹר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאָדָ֖ם עַד בְּהֵמָ֑ה לִ֥י יִהְי֖וּ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses in wilderness of Sinai, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, saying,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינַ֖י לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Count sons of Levi by houses of fathers, by clans; every male from one month old and upward you shall count.

familiar.text: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.

modern.text: “Number the Levites by their families and clans. You are to count every male a month old or more.”

original.text: פְּקֹד֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם כָּל זָכָ֛ר מִבֶּן חֹ֥דֶשׁ וָמַ֖עְלָה תִּפְקְדֵֽם

verses.restored: Moses counted them by mouth of YHWH, as he was commanded.

familiar.text: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.

modern.text: So Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he had been commanded.

original.text: וַיִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַל פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צֻוָּֽה

verses.restored: These were sons of Levi by names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

familiar.text: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

modern.text: These were the sons of Levi by name: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

original.text: וַיִּֽהְיוּ אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי לֵוִ֖י בִּשְׁמֹתָ֑ם גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן וּקְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִֽי

verses.restored: These are names of sons of Gershon by clans: Libni and Shimei.

familiar.text: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.

modern.text: These were the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans: Libni and Shimei.

original.text: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי גֵרְשׁ֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם לִבְנִ֖י וְשִׁמְעִֽי

verses.restored: Sons of Kohath by clans: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

familiar.text: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

modern.text: The sons of Kohath by their clans were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

original.text: וּבְנֵ֥י קְהָ֖ת לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם עַמְרָ֣ם וְיִצְהָ֔ר חֶבְר֖וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל

verses.restored: Sons of Merari by clans: Mahli and Mushi. These are clans of Levites by houses of fathers.

familiar.text: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.

modern.text: And the sons of Merari by their clans were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Levites, according to their families. The Gershonites (Numbers 4:21–28; 1 Chronicles 23:7–11)

original.text: וּבְנֵ֧י מְרָרִ֛י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֛ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַלֵּוִ֖י לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם

verses.restored: To Gershon belonged clan of Libnites and clan of Shimeites; these are clans of Gershonites.

familiar.text: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.

modern.text: From Gershon came the Libnite clan and the Shimeite clan; these were the Gershonite clans.

original.text: לְגֵ֣רְשׁ֔וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַלִּבְנִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשִּׁמְעִ֑י אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֔ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי

verses.restored: Those counted of them by number of every male from one month old and upward were seven thousand five hundred.

familiar.text: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.

modern.text: The number of all the males a month old or more was 7,500.

original.text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר כָּל זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה פְּקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת

verses.restored: Clans of Gershonites shall camp behind dwelling-place westward.

familiar.text: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.

modern.text: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west, behind the tabernacle,

original.text: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אַחֲרֵ֧י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן יַחֲנ֖וּ יָֽמָּה

verses.restored: Leader of fathers' house of Gershonites: Eliasaph son of Lael.

familiar.text: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.

modern.text: and the leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.

original.text: וּנְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית אָ֖ב לַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן לָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Charge of sons of Gershon in tent of meeting: dwelling-place, tent, its covering, screen of entrance of tent of meeting,

familiar.text: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

modern.text: The duties of the Gershonites at the Tent of Meeting were the tabernacle and tent, its covering, the curtain for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,

original.text: וּמִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת בְּנֵֽי גֵרְשׁוֹן֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְהָאֹ֑הֶל מִכְסֵ֕הוּ וּמָסַ֕ךְ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: hangings of courtyard, screen of entrance of courtyard around dwelling-place and altar, and its cords for all its service.

familiar.text: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.

modern.text: the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and altar, and the cords—all the service for these items. The Kohathites (Numbers 4:1–20; 1 Chronicles 23:12–20)

original.text: וְקַלְעֵ֣י הֶֽחָצֵ֗ר וְאֶת מָסַךְ֙ פֶּ֣תַח הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֧ר עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְעַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִ֑יב וְאֵת֙ מֵֽיתָרָ֔יו לְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: To Kohath belonged clan of Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and Uzzielites; these are clans of Kohathites.

familiar.text: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.

modern.text: From Kohath came the clans of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites; these were the clans of the Kohathites.

original.text: וְלִקְהָ֗ת מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַֽעַמְרָמִי֙ וּמִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַיִּצְהָרִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַֽחֶבְרֹנִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָֽעָזִּיאֵלִ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַקְּהָתִֽי

verses.restored: By number of every male from one month old and upward were eight thousand six hundred, keeping charge of holy place.

familiar.text: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.

modern.text: The number of all the males a month old or more was 8,600. They were responsible for the duties of the sanctuary.

original.text: בְּמִסְפַּר֙ כָּל זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה שְׁמֹנַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: Clans of sons of Kohath shall camp on side of dwelling-place southward.

familiar.text: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.

modern.text: The clans of the Kohathites were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle,

original.text: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת בְּנֵי קְהָ֖ת יַחֲנ֑וּ עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן תֵּימָֽנָה

verses.restored: Leader of fathers' house of clans of Kohathites: Elizaphan son of Uzziel.

familiar.text: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

modern.text: and the leader of the families of the Kohathites was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.

original.text: וּנְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית אָ֖ב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י אֶלִיצָפָ֖ן בֶּן עֻזִּיאֵֽל

verses.restored: Their charge: ark, table, lampstand, altars, vessels of holy place with which they serve, screen, and all its service.

familiar.text: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.

modern.text: Their duties were the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the articles of the sanctuary used with them, and the curtain—all the service for these items.

original.text: וּמִשְׁמַרְתָּ֗ם הָאָרֹ֤ן וְהַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְהַמְּנֹרָ֣ה וְהַֽמִּזְבְּחֹ֔ת וּכְלֵ֣י הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשָׁרְת֖וּ בָּהֶ֑ם וְהַ֨מָּסָ֔ךְ וְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: Chief of leaders of Levites: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, oversight of those keeping charge of holy place.

familiar.text: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.

modern.text: The chief of the leaders of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest; he oversaw those responsible for the duties of the sanctuary. The Merarites (Numbers 4:29–33; 1 Chronicles 23:21–23)

original.text: וּנְשִׂיא֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַלֵּוִ֔י אֶלְעָזָ֖ר בֶּן אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן פְּקֻדַּ֕ת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: To Merari belonged clan of Mahlites and clan of Mushites; these are clans of Merari.

familiar.text: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.

modern.text: From Merari came the clans of the Mahlites and Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.

original.text: לִמְרָרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַמַּחְלִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַמּוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת מְרָרִֽי

translation_notes: Levites substitute for firstborn in a ritual-service economy; this is consecrated service, not superiority.
The census includes Levite males from one month old because it concerns substitution/identity, not military readiness.
Clan assignments distribute burdens of transport and care around the dwelling-place.
Redemption silver addresses the numerical excess of firstborn over Levites; it must not be interpreted as pricing human worth.
Nadab and Abihu are recalled as a warning about unauthorized priestly approach, not as permission for fear-based control.
safety_note: Do not use Numbers 3 to rank clergy over others, price human lives, or justify lethal gatekeeping. The chapter organizes sacred service and symbolic substitution within ancient Israel.
